title: Fiesta Beef
description: Lean minced beef simmered one-pot style with rice, peppers, tomatoes, pinto beans, sweetcorn and taco spices, topped with melted Cheddar and grilled until golden.
ingredients: 400g can pinto beans, drained and rinsed
juice of 1 lime (plus lime wedges to serve)
To serve: sliced spring onions, chopped red chilli
steps: Spray a large casserole with cooking spray; fry onion, garlic and beef gently for 8 minutes, breaking up the meat.
Stir in spice mix; cook 1 minute. Stir in peppers.
Add rice; stir through; pour in stock.
Tip in tomatoes, beans, lime juice and sweetcorn; simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Preheat grill to highest setting.
Check rice is cooked; stir in milk with three-quarters of the cheese.
Sprinkle remaining cheese on top; grill 4 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Serve sprinkled with spring onions and red chilli, with lime wedges.
notes: Make vegetarian by swapping beef for black beans and beef stock for vegetable stock.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
